mathematics.assertion_tested: Compare seven matched central3x3-pixel sightlines in dirty, clean_conv and clean_conv_contsub cubes over common native line channels and sparse identical off-line baseline anchors. This is central brightness localization, not a total-flux comparison.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: float64; image Jy/beam, frequency Hz, angular sizes arcsec
mathematics.conventions: Same source coordinates, aperture radius (CFG302 line-window beam median times 1.5), frequency channels, beam area and line windows for pre/post stages. Baseline masks and robust constant/linear residual fits follow the previous profile analysis, with common window halfwidth=max(150,max(MIGHTEE W50,ALFALFA W50)/2+50) km/s; expansions0,100,250. Frequency-bin overlap integrals convert JyHz by c/nu_center. Pre means after visibility-domain continuum subtraction, deconvolution, resolution homogenization and mosaicking but before final image-domain subtraction; it is NOT raw visibilities.
inputs: Seven primary matches from preceding profile comparison
Public clean_conv r1p0 FITS range cutouts
Existing ALFALFA spectra and independent catalogue measurements
Heywood et al 2024 sections3.2-3.6 and table2

bounds.baseline_anchors: abs(v)>halfwidth+350 and abs(v)<1800, every sixth global channel

non_claims: Cannot isolate pre-imaging continuum subtraction or calibration from already reduced cube products
A smoothing simulation is not a reproduction of unpinned historical pipeline code

disclosure: All preceding profile flux ratios and pipeline paper descriptions have already been seen. This is an exploratory stage-localization experiment. No pre-subtraction line pixels have been read before this contract. This dirty-stage diagnostic was added after observing the final continuum subtraction accounts for only a minority of the seven-pair deficit. No dirty brightness ratios were inspected before defining this test.

hypotheses.image_continuum: If final image-domain subtraction is responsible, pre-subtraction line flux after independently fitting a broad residual baseline should be substantially larger and closer to ALFALFA; the paired removed component should contain line-shaped signal.
hypotheses.simple_beam_area: To explain a median ratio0.43 solely by a Gaussian beam-area denominator, the actual effective FWHM would need to be about sqrt(0.43) times the header FWHM for an unresolved source. Check local line-map shapes and documented beam conventions. Source extension makes an observed fitted width an upper, not equality, constraint.
hypotheses.residual_normalization: Paper explicitly homogenizes residual PSFs separately from model restoration. A missing or incorrect residual scale cannot be claimed from the generic Jy/dirty-beam issue alone; exact PSFs/model/residual products or pinned production code would be required.
